limitations: Workspace installation is restricted to workspace admins unless an admin enables member app installs.
Listing in Slack App Directory requires App Directory Review and strict privacy/security compliance.

assumptions: Developer has access to a Slack test workspace with admin permissions
Using granular bot token scopes (chat:write, channels:read)

externalWait.publishedRange: No wait for single-workspace or custom OAuth install; 1-3 weeks for Slack App Directory review

prerequisites.text: Slack development workspace where you are an Administrator

steps.title: Create a New Slack App in api.slack.com
steps.instructions: Navigate to api.slack.com/apps. Click 'Create New App'. Choose 'From scratch'. Provide an App Name (e.g. 'Support Bot') and pick your development Slack workspace.
steps.completionCheck: Basic Information dashboard for the new Slack app opens.

steps.title: Configure OAuth Redirect URLs
steps.instructions: In the left sidebar, click 'OAuth & Permissions'. Scroll down to 'Redirect URLs'. Click 'Add New Redirect URL' and enter your callback URL (e.g. `https://app.example.com/api/auth/callback/slack`). Click 'Save URLs'.
steps.completionCheck: Redirect URL is listed and verified under Redirect URLs.

steps.title: Add Bot Scopes (Granular Permissions)
steps.instructions: Under 'OAuth & Permissions' > 'Scopes' > 'Bot Token Scopes', click 'Add an OAuth Scope'. Add essential scopes: `chat:write` (send messages), `commands` (add slash commands), and `channels:read` (read public channel metadata). Avoid requesting User Token Scopes unless acting as the individual user.
steps.completionCheck: Selected scopes appear in the Bot Token Scopes table.

steps.title: Enable Public Distribution (For Multi-Workspace OAuth)
steps.instructions: In the left sidebar, navigate to 'Manage Distribution'. Ensure all checklist requirements have green checkmarks. Click 'Activate Public Distribution' if users outside your primary workspace need to install your app via OAuth.
steps.completionCheck: Shareable 'Add to Slack' URL and client credentials become active for external workspaces.

steps.title: Retrieve Client ID and Client Secret
steps.instructions: Go back to 'Basic Information' > 'App Credentials'. Copy the Client ID, Client Secret, and Signing Secret into your server environment variables.
steps.completionCheck: Credentials copied into your application backend config.

blockers.title: Workspace Admin Approval Barrier
blockers.description: If an end-user in an enterprise workspace attempts to authorize the Slack App, the OAuth flow may pause with an 'Admin Approval Needed' request.

claims.text: Every Slack App has a unique Client ID and Client Secret managed in api.slack.com.
Redirect URLs must use HTTPS in production; HTTP is only allowed for localhost in testing.
Slack OAuth v2 uses granular Bot Token scopes (`xoxb-`) separate from user tokens (`xoxp-`).
Activating Public Distribution allows installation across any Slack workspace without listing on the public App Directory.

selectedPassages: Slack uses OAuth 2.0 to authorize applications and provide access to workspaces.
Apps can be installed into multiple workspaces by activating Public Distribution.
